$comment: Store listing fields that apify push never sends. Applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs after every deploy. Title, description and categories live in actor.json (copied from the live listing on 2026-10-29, so adding the CI kit changed nothing else).
seoTitle: Betterleaks Cloud - GitHub Secret Scanner + Validator
seoDescription: Find leaked API keys & wallet private keys across GitHub orgs, users, PRs, gists & S3 buckets. Uses Betterleaks (Gitleaks successor). Optional live validation probes against vendor APIs.
exampleRunInput$comment: The prefill (a demo .env with fake secrets, stdin mode). Until 2026-10-29 the live example was the template's { "helloWorld": 123 }.

exampleRunInput.stdin_content:
# demo .env scanned by Betterleaks (stdin mode)
DB_HOST=db.internal.example.com
GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_A1b2C3d4E5f6G7h8I9j0K1l2M3n4O5p6Q7r8
-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIEvQIBADANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAASCBKcwggSjAgEAAoIBAQDfakefakefakeKEY
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----

defaultRunOptions$comment: 2 GB since 2026-10-30, as gitleaks-github-secret-scanner, which scans repos the same way: the stdin example peaked at 52-56 MB (runs 5iZvQgcd2MJjVQNmB, jLFchzW0c3v8mArL5). The start fee is a flat event, so the 4 GB default only doubled the compute Apify bills us per run.

pricing.$comment: Store discounts (owner's Gentle ladder, rolled out 2026-10-29 after holehe and social-analyzer): Free and Starter keep the flat price, Scale pays 10% less, Business and above 20% less; apify-actor-start stays flat. Aug-Oct paid revenue of this actor came almost all from Starter, and Apify bills our platform cost of Scale and Business runs lower only when discounts are on (compute $0.16 and $0.13 per CU instead of $0.20, https://docs.apify.com/actors/monetize/pricing-and-costs.md). The CI script applies first-time pricing and decreases; increases go through Console with 14 days' notice.

actor_start.eventDescription: Charged once per run. Covers actor boot, betterleaks binary cold-start, and result aggregation.

per_repo_scanned.eventDescription: Charged once per repository scanned. Covers the main work unit: clone (if applicable), full history scan with betterleaks, and finding extraction. For github mode with an org/user URL, charges once per repo in the org. For global_github mode, charges once per discovered+scanned repo.

per_finding.eventDescription: Charged for each detected secret pushed to the dataset. Low per-item cost; scales with scan output.

per_validated_live.eventDescription: Premium event. Charged ONLY when validation is enabled AND the vendor API confirms the secret is currently valid (ValidationStatus=valid). Dead/invalid/revoked findings do NOT incur this charge. This is the high-signal output.

per_code_search_query.eventDescription: Charged when global_github mode uses GitHub Code Search API to discover candidate repos. Fires once per discovery session.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: Store discounts: Scale plans pay 10% less and Business and enterprise plans 20% less. Free and Starter prices are unchanged.
